_comment: The categories used to record what people object to, or support, when a
solar project is proposed near them. Read by both the crawler (to suggest)
and the page (to code against), so there is only one copy.
id      goes into the exported column names. Changing one after coding has
label   what appears in the interface.
hint    what counts, for whoever is coding.
cues    words that raise a suggestion. Suggestions are not codes.
Add a category by copying a block. Nothing else needs to change.

categories.label: Loss of farmland
categories.hint: Productive or prime agricultural land taken out of farming.

categories.label: Tree and forest clearing
categories.hint: Removing woodland, core forest, or protected individual trees.

categories.label: Wrong land for it
categories.hint: The site is zoned for, or better suited to, some other use. Includes calls to build on industrial or already disturbed land instead.

categories.label: Views and visual impact
categories.hint: How it looks: sightlines, scenic vistas, panel glare, screening.

categories.label: Rural character
categories.hint: That an industrial facility does not belong in a rural or small-town place.

categories.label: Recreation and tourism
categories.hint: Lost access to hunting, fishing, boating, trails, parks, or visitor economy. Common where panels go over water.

categories.label: Property values
categories.hint: That nearby property will be worth less.

categories.label: Doubt about promised benefits
categories.hint: That tax revenue, jobs or local power do not materialize, or go elsewhere. Includes the power leaving the county.

categories.label: Decommissioning and end of life
categories.hint: Who removes the panels, whether a bond is posted, what happens to the equipment afterward.

categories.label: Wildlife and habitat
categories.hint: Animals, birds, pollinators, migration corridors, habitat connectivity.

categories.label: Water quality and supply
categories.hint: Wells, aquifers, groundwater, runoff reaching drinking water, water the project uses. Central to canal and reservoir siting.

categories.label: Drainage, erosion, dust
categories.hint: Stormwater, flooding, soil erosion during construction, dust from grading.

categories.label: Heat and microclimate
categories.hint: That a large array raises local temperature or changes local weather.

categories.label: Fire risk
categories.hint: Ignition, spread, or difficulty fighting a fire at the site. Most common where batteries are included.

categories.label: Noise
categories.hint: Sound from inverters, transformers, or construction.

categories.label: Health effects
categories.hint: That the facility makes people sick. Includes claims with no scientific support, recorded as stated rather than endorsed.

categories.label: Traffic and road damage
categories.hint: Construction traffic, heavy equipment, who pays to repair county roads.

categories.label: Notice and public process
categories.hint: Short notice, no hearing, rushed vote, records withheld, surveyors on private land.

categories.label: Distrust of the developer
categories.hint: Out-of-state ownership, changed plans, inconsistent filings, hidden funding behind the campaign on either side.

categories.label: Local control and preemption
categories.hint: A state agency or state law overriding the county or town.

categories.label: Who benefits, who lives with it
categories.hint: Leasing landowners paid while neighbors carry the effects; absentee owners deciding for residents.

categories.label: Tribal consultation and sovereignty
categories.hint: Raised by a tribe or nation, including inadequate consultation.

categories.label: Sacred and historic sites
categories.hint: Burial grounds, cultural landscapes, archaeological resources, historic districts.

categories.label: Tax revenue and local funding
categories.hint: In favor: county revenue, school funding, lease payments, scholarships.

categories.label: Jobs and construction work
categories.hint: In favor: construction jobs, long-term operations jobs.

categories.label: Local or clean energy supply
categories.hint: In favor: more locally produced power, climate benefit, grid reliability.

categories.label: Concessions won by neighbors
categories.hint: Where objection produced setbacks, screening, fencing, conserved acreage, or a community benefit agreement.
